# Method GetPatterns

#### GetPatterns(DocumentId)

Gets the pattern entities that are in the pattern folder of a document.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 400, 180)]
List<ElementId> GetPatterns(DocumentId inDocumentId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  DocumentId |  inDocumentId |  Identifier of the document to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<ElementId> |  Points entities found.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.20.
